name: KIC 5902477
description: A red-clump giant burning helium in its core in the Kepler field, 9.8 solar radii and 1.86 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 5902477 (Gold): Radius (Mosser scale, solar radii) 9.7642 +/- 0.181

mass.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 5902477 (Gold): Mass (Mosser scale, solar masses) 1.8625 +/- 0.0764

temperature.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 5902477 (Gold): APOGEE effective temperature (K) 4902.303 +/- 46.5204

gravity.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 5902477 (Gold): Asteroseismic log g 2.7316 +/- 0.0041

color.reason: The star lies in the Galactic plane hundreds to thousands of parsecs away, where interstellar dust reddens its spectra, and the colour routes do not remove it; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red-clump giant in the Kepler field, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations give 1.86 solar masses and 9.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,902 K at its surface.
